rules.name: CLS Optimization Hints
rules.description: Finds static markup hints for layout shift risk; it does not measure browser or field CLS

rules.name: Compression
rules.description: Checks for Gzip or Brotli compression

rules.name: Page Content Shipped in a JavaScript Bundle
rules.description: Flags a same-origin JavaScript chunk that contains the text of the site's pages (compiled MDX or Markdown bodies, inlined CMS JSON), so the content downloads twice

rules.name: Critical Request Chains
rules.description: Finds static HTML hints for render-blocking resources; it does not measure browser request dependencies

rules.name: CSS File Size Too Large
rules.description: Checks for CSS files that exceed recommended size limits

rules.name: DOM Size
rules.description: Detects excessive DOM complexity that impacts performance

rules.name: Duplicate JavaScript
rules.description: Detects duplicate JavaScript libraries loaded multiple times

rules.name: Font Delivery
rules.description: Flags render-blocking third-party font stylesheets in the critical request chain

rules.name: Font Loading
rules.description: Checks for font loading best practices

rules.name: Large Framework Data Payload on a Static Page
rules.description: Flags a page that is mostly text but carries a large inline framework data payload (__NEXT_DATA__, the Next.js app router flight data, __NUXT__, Remix, Qwik, SvelteKit or Astro island state)

rules.name: HTTP/2
rules.description: Checks for HTTP/2 protocol support

rules.name: INP Optimization Hints
rules.description: Checks for Interaction to Next Paint optimization

rules.name: JavaScript File Size Too Large
rules.description: Checks for JavaScript files that exceed recommended size limits

rules.name: JS Libraries
rules.description: Detects JavaScript libraries and checks for known vulnerabilities

rules.name: JavaScript Redirects
rules.description: Detects JavaScript resources that return 3XX redirects

rules.name: Lazy Loading Above Fold
rules.description: Detects lazy loading on likely above-fold images

rules.name: LCP Image Fetch Priority
rules.description: Flags the hero/LCP image when it is eagerly loaded but has neither fetchpriority='high' nor a preload

rules.name: LCP Optimization Hints
rules.description: Finds static HTML hints for likely LCP optimization; it does not measure browser or field LCP

rules.name: Legacy JavaScript
rules.description: Detects ES5 polyfills and legacy JavaScript code

rules.name: Preconnect Hints
rules.description: Checks for preconnect hints to critical third-party origins

rules.name: Render-Blocking Resources
rules.description: Checks for render-blocking CSS and JavaScript, and flags blocking scripts that were slow to respond

rules.name: Source Maps
rules.description: Checks for source map availability and configuration

rules.name: Total Page Weight
rules.description: Checks the byte weight of each page

rules.name: Time to First Byte
rules.description: Measures server response time (TTFB)

rules.name: Unminified CSS
rules.description: Detects unminified CSS that could be optimized

rules.name: Unminified JavaScript
rules.description: Detects unminified JavaScript that could be optimized

rules.name: Forms That Lose Submissions
rules.description: Checks that form fields are submitted (they have a name) and that form actions answer, not 404, a staging host or mailto:

rules.name: Broken Scripts, Stylesheets and Fonts
rules.description: Checks that the scripts, stylesheets and fonts pages reference load, and reports 4xx/5xx or failed requests

rules.name: JavaScript Errors and Failed Runtime Requests
rules.description: Reports uncaught JavaScript exceptions, hydration mismatches, console errors and failed runtime requests seen while rendering pages, grouped across the site

rules.name: Article Schema
rules.description: Validates Article schema required properties

rules.name: Breadcrumb Schema
rules.description: Checks for BreadcrumbList schema on non-homepage

rules.name: Structured Data Coverage Outlier
rules.description: Finds pages missing the structured data the rest of their page type carries

rules.name: Author Entities
rules.description: Finds a site with article authorship but no Person entity, or Person entities with nothing to identify them by

rules.name: Entity Property Conflicts
rules.description: Finds an entity whose name, logo, url, sameAs, telephone, address or email differs between the pages that declare it

rules.name: Dangling Entity References
rules.description: Finds a JSON-LD reference pointing at an @id that no crawled page declares

rules.name: Entity @id Format
rules.description: Finds an @id that is not an absolute URL, which makes the entity page-local rather than site-wide

rules.name: Entity Identity
rules.description: Finds an Organization, LocalBusiness, Person or WebSite declared on many pages with no @id to tie the declarations together

rules.name: LocalBusiness On Every Page
rules.description: Finds a LocalBusiness declared in full on nearly every page rather than once and referenced

rules.name: Organization Entity
rules.description: Finds a site that presents as a business but declares no Organization or LocalBusiness entity

rules.name: Orphan Entities
rules.description: Finds an entity with a stable @id that nothing references and that appears on one page only

rules.name: Publisher Mismatch
rules.description: Finds articles or a WebSite whose publisher points somewhere other than the site's primary organization

rules.name: Organization sameAs
rules.description: Finds a primary Organization or LocalBusiness with no sameAs links to the profiles that identify it

rules.name: Split Entity Identity
rules.description: Finds one entity declared under two or more different @ids, which a search engine reads as two different things

rules.name: Entity Type Drift
rules.description: Finds one @id declared with different @type sets on different pages

rules.name: WebSite Entity
rules.description: Finds a site with no WebSite entity, or page entities that do not link back to it with isPartOf

rules.name: Expected schema for page type
rules.description: Flags a page the classifier confidently reads as a product, article, contact, about, docs or listing page when it declares none of the structured data that type should carry

rules.name: FAQ Schema
rules.description: Validates FAQPage schema structure

rules.name: JSON-LD Valid
rules.description: Validates JSON-LD structured data

rules.name: LocalBusiness Schema
rules.description: Validates LocalBusiness schema for local SEO

rules.name: Organization Schema
rules.description: Validates Organization schema for brand presence

rules.name: Product Schema
rules.description: Validates Product schema for e-commerce

rules.name: Rating Scope
rules.description: Checks AggregateRating is about the page's subject and visible to readers

rules.name: Review Schema
rules.description: Validates Review and AggregateRating schema

rules.name: Video Schema
rules.description: Validates VideoObject schema for video content

rules.name: WebSite Search Schema
rules.description: Checks for WebSite schema with sitelinks searchbox

rules.name: Auth Endpoint Disclosure
rules.description: Probes the site's current-user and session endpoints (such as /api/me and /api/session) with a GET that carries no credentials, and flags a JSON answer that contains a password, a password hash, a credential secret or the internal user record. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive, on the audited origin only.

rules.name: Client-Side-Only Authorization
rules.description: Finds admin and other privileged API endpoints referenced in the site's own JavaScript, sends each one GET without cookies or credentials, and flags an endpoint that answers with data. If an admin API answers anyone, the frontend is the only gate. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive.

rules.name: Cookie Flags
rules.description: Checks Set-Cookie response headers for Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes

rules.name: Content Security Policy
rules.description: Checks for Content-Security-Policy header and validates directives

rules.name: CSP blocks the page's own resources
rules.description: Checks that the page's Content-Security-Policy allows the scripts, frames, styles, images and vendor endpoints the page itself depends on

rules.name: CSP Violations During Render
rules.description: Reports the resources the browser blocked under the page's Content-Security-Policy while the page rendered, grouped by blocked host and directive

rules.name: Exposed Spring Boot Actuator
rules.description: Probes the site's Spring Boot Actuator paths with read-only GET requests and flags endpoints that answer anyone: env, configprops and heapdump leak secrets and memory (critical), the index and mappings map the application. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive; the heapdump only when aggressive.

rules.name: Exposed Backup Copies
rules.description: Requests backup and temporary copies of crawled server-side files (page.php.bak, page.php~, .page.php.swp, page.php.zip and the like) and flags each one the site serves, confirmed by its content: source code, an archive, a Vim swap file or an SQL dump. Runs only when probing is aggressive.

rules.name: Exposed Sensitive Files
rules.description: Requests a short, curated list of sensitive files that should never be public (.git and other version control metadata, .env files, configuration backups, server status pages, database dumps, .DS_Store) and flags each one the site serves, confirmed by its content, not its status code. Runs only when probing is aggressive.

rules.name: Firebase open security rules
rules.description: Finds the Firebase Realtime Database URL and Firestore project the site's scripts ship, then makes one unauthenticated REST read to each database and to each collection its own code queries. A database or collection that answers data to a caller with no sign-in has open security rules. Only key and collection names are read, never values. A loud probe: runs only with --probe aggressive.

rules.name: Form CAPTCHA
rules.description: Checks static markup for client-side CAPTCHA signals on public forms; server-side abuse controls are not observable

rules.name: Form HTTPS
rules.description: Checks that form actions use HTTPS

rules.name: GraphQL Mutations over GET
rules.description: Probes the site's GraphQL endpoints with a no-op mutation sent over GET and flags an endpoint that executes it, which exposes every mutation to cross-site request forgery. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive.

rules.name: GraphQL Introspection
rules.description: Probes the site's GraphQL endpoints with a read-only introspection query and flags an endpoint that returns its full schema, which maps the whole API for an attacker. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive.

rules.name: HSTS Header
rules.description: Checks for HTTP Strict Transport Security header

rules.name: Dangerous HTTP methods
rules.description: Sends OPTIONS to the site root and up to two crawled pages and flags TRACE, TRACK, PUT, DELETE, PATCH or CONNECT in the Allow header. When TRACE is advertised it sends one TRACE with a marker header to confirm the server reflects the request. Never sends PUT, DELETE, PATCH or CONNECT. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive.

rules.name: HTTP to HTTPS Redirect
rules.description: Checks whether HTTP URLs redirect to HTTPS

rules.name: HTTPS
rules.description: Checks for HTTPS usage

rules.name: Leaked Secrets and API Keys
rules.description: Checks for exposed API keys, secrets, and credentials in HTML, comments, scripts, framework data payloads, same-origin source maps and config endpoints

rules.name: Mixed Content
rules.description: Checks for HTTP resources on HTTPS pages

rules.name: External Link Security
rules.description: Flags external target=_blank links that explicitly opt in to window.opener (rel="opener" without noopener or noreferrer), and notes missing noreferrer as a privacy choice

rules.name: Open Redirect
rules.description: Probes same-origin URLs whose query carries a redirect-shaped parameter (next, url, redirect, returnTo, continue and the like) with an off-site value, and flags a parameter the server redirects to whatever host it names. The redirect is never followed. Runs only when probing is active or aggressive.

rules.name: Password form method
rules.description: Checks that forms with a password field do not submit by GET

rules.name: Permissions-Policy
rules.description: Checks for Permissions-Policy (Feature-Policy) header

rules.name: Query Parameter Error Pages
rules.description: Changes one query value at a time on same-origin URLs to a short fixed list of harmless tokens (a quote, a double quote, a NUL byte, an empty array, a very large number, a negative number) and flags a parameter whose answer is a PHP, database or framework error page the unmodified request did not show. GET only. Runs only when probing is aggressive.

rules.name: Referrer-Policy
rules.description: Checks for Referrer-Policy header

rules.name: security.txt
rules.description: Checks for a valid RFC 9116 security.txt so security researchers know how to report a vulnerability

rules.name: Subresource Integrity
rules.description: Checks that cross-origin scripts and stylesheets use Subresource Integrity (SRI)

rules.name: Supabase Row Level Security
rules.description: Finds the Supabase project and public anon key the site ships, then sends one HEAD request with a row count to each table its own code queries, using that key. A table that reports rows to the anon key is readable by anyone: Row Level Security is off or a policy allows it. No row is read. A loud probe: runs only with --probe aggressive.

rules.name: Third-Party Cookies
rules.description: Detects third-party resources that may set cookies

rules.name: TLS Certificate
rules.description: Checks the TLS certificate for expiry, hostname coverage, a complete chain and key strength

rules.name: Auth Tokens in Web Storage
rules.description: Flags JWTs and session or access tokens written to localStorage or sessionStorage

rules.name: Version-Revealing Headers
rules.description: Checks Server, X-Powered-By, X-AspNet-Version, X-AspNetMvc-Version and X-Generator for software version numbers

rules.name: X-Content-Type-Options
rules.description: Checks for MIME type sniffing protection

rules.name: X-Frame-Options
rules.description: Checks for clickjacking protection header

rules.name: Site Asset Consistency
rules.description: Finds pages whose favicon, theme-color or default OG image differs from the rest of the site

rules.name: OG Image Size
rules.description: Checks social images use a supported format and recommended dimensions

rules.name: OG URL Match
rules.description: Checks that og:url matches canonical URL

rules.name: Share Buttons
rules.description: Checks for social sharing buttons on content pages

rules.name: Social Profiles
rules.description: Checks for links to social media profiles

rules.name: URL Hyphens
rules.description: Checks that URLs use hyphens, not underscores

rules.name: URL Length
rules.description: Checks URL length for optimal SEO

rules.name: URL Lowercase
rules.description: Checks that URLs are lowercase

rules.name: URL Parameters
rules.description: Checks for excessive URL parameters

rules.name: Session IDs in URLs
rules.description: Checks that crawlable URLs do not carry a session ID

rules.name: URL Convention Consistency
rules.description: Finds URLs that break the site's own URL conventions

rules.name: Slug Keywords
rules.description: Checks if URL slug contains relevant keywords

rules.name: URL Special Characters
rules.description: Checks for problematic special characters in URL path

rules.name: URL Stop Words
rules.description: Flags common stop words in URL slugs

rules.name: Trailing Slash
rules.description: Checks for consistent trailing slash usage

rules.name: Video Accessibility
rules.description: Checks for video captions and transcripts

rules.name: Video Schema
rules.description: Checks for VideoObject schema on pages with video

rules.name: Video Thumbnail
rules.description: Checks that videos have poster/thumbnail images
